integrity: Theorem and reproducible finite checks are included; finite computations are not the general proof. No independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to geometric column-reflection fixed sets of four-robust clique complexes of three-row grids at widths at least three. Does not classify the ordinary full-complex homotopy type; independent audit is outstanding.
title: Column-reflection fixed loci of four-robust clique complexes of three-row grids
